sloka: मा चोत्कण्थां कृथा देव वने रम्स्यामहे वयम् ।प्रशान्तहरिणाकीर्णे नानाशकुनिनादिते ॥२-३४-५१॥
transliteration: mā cotkaṇthāṁ kṛthā deva vane ramsyāmahe vayam ।praśāntahariṇākīrṇe nānāśakuninādite ॥2-34-51॥

translations.english: Do not worry, O Lord We will enjoy (our stay in) the peaceful forest full of deer and resounding with the chirpings of various birds.
